Inspection of the raw NGS position files revealed that `x` and `y` coordinates are exact multiples of 0.01 yd with no exceptions—multiplying by 100 gives an integer 100.00% of the time. The difference histogram test showed that 100.00% of successive differences (`x[t]-x[t-1]`) land exactly on the 0.01 yd grid, with discrete spikes at 0, ±0.01, ±0.02, and nothing in between.
